## Your task

Add your own page to the class handbook, and add your row to the roster.

## Steps

- [ ] Assign this issue to yourself
- [ ] Create a branch named `docs/add-<yourname>-page`
- [ ] Add `docs/<yourname>.md`, starting from `docs/_template.md`
- [ ] Add your row to your team's table in `index.md`
- [ ] Open a pull request with `Closes #<this issue number>` in the description
- [ ] Request a review from your pair
- [ ] Review your pair's pull request and approve it
- [ ] Merge once approved

## Branch naming

Real teams name branches `type/short-description`, lowercase, hyphenated.

Yours today is a documentation change, so:

```
docs/add-<yourname>-page
```

The full convention, and the reasons behind it, are in CONTRIBUTING.md.

## Where to look if you're stuck

CONTRIBUTING.md has every step, in order, with exactly where to click.

Ask your pair first, then the room, then the instructor.
